title: Opening
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-life-sim/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Secretary>>
You're late. Again.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The city kept me up.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
The city doesn't pay rent. The landlord came by twice.
<<speaker, Detective>>
How much do we have?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Enough for the phone bill or the light bill. Pick one.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Keep the phone. I can work in the dark.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Good. Because the phone rang at eight. Vivian Ash.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The Vivian Ash? Hill money?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Someone stole her gem last night. The Crimson Heart. She wants us on it today.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Why us?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
She asked for someone discreet. I think she meant cheap.
Mrs. Ash can wait a day. The landlord can't wait a week.
<<speaker, Detective>>
So what's the plan?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Seven days. Pay the rent and stay on your feet. How you spend them is your business.
<<jump, Day>>

title: RentPaid
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-life-sim/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Seven days and the rent is paid. The landlord even said thank you.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Write that down. It won't happen again.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
I already did. In ink.

title: RentPaidWornOut
body:
